purpose: Stable FireOpsSim resource catalog for FireOps Career Roadmap Taskbooks.
disclaimer: FireOpsSim content is training/reference material, not an official skill sheet or certification authority. Verify department SOPs, state requirements, medical direction, current standards, and issuing-agency rules.

officialSources.label: National Fire Academy
officialSources.scope: Fire and EMS professional development courses

officialSources.label: FEMA Independent Study
officialSources.scope: Free ICS/NIMS and emergency management courses

officialSources.label: CAAHEP Find an Accredited Program
officialSources.scope: Accredited allied health education programs, including paramedic programs

firefighter_1.title: Firefighter I
firefighter_1.summary: Build the entry-level knowledge and hands-on foundation expected of a structural firefighter. Exact certification requirements vary by state and agency.

firefighter_2.title: Firefighter II
firefighter_2.summary: Build beyond Firefighter I into advanced company-level skills, operations, communications, and readiness. Requirements vary by certifying authority.

hazmat_awareness.title: Hazardous Materials Awareness
hazmat_awareness.summary: Recognition, isolation, notification, protective actions, and safe initial decision-making. Use the requirements adopted by your agency/state.

hazmat_operations.title: Hazardous Materials Operations
hazmat_operations.summary: Operations-level defensive actions, PPE, decontamination, control zones, and risk-based response. Scope varies by local adoption and certification authority.

hazmat_technician.title: Hazardous Materials Technician
hazmat_technician.summary: Advanced technician development should be anchored to the certifying authority, team SOPs, equipment, chemistry, monitoring, control, and decon requirements.

driver_operator_pumper.title: Driver Operator – Pumper
driver_operator_pumper.summary: Build apparatus, driving, pump, hydraulics, water-supply, and troubleshooting competence. Use apparatus-specific manufacturer guidance and department SOPs for actual operation.

driver_operator_aerial.title: Driver Operator – Aerial
driver_operator_aerial.summary: Develop safe driving, placement, stabilization, aerial-device operation, load awareness, communications, and apparatus-specific proficiency.

fire_officer_1.title: Fire Officer I
fire_officer_1.summary: Company-officer development: leadership, supervision, communications, crew development, incident decision-making, documentation, and organizational responsibilities.

fire_officer_2.title: Fire Officer II
fire_officer_2.summary: Advanced company-officer development emphasizing administration, personnel development, planning, policy application, incident leadership, and organizational performance.

fire_instructor_1.title: Fire Instructor I
fire_instructor_1.summary: Prepare to deliver safe, organized instruction from prepared lesson plans, coach skills, evaluate learners, and document training.

fire_instructor_2.title: Fire Instructor II
fire_instructor_2.summary: Advance into lesson-plan development, evaluation, program coordination, instructional improvement, and more complex training responsibilities.

fire_inspector_1.title: Fire Inspector I
fire_inspector_1.summary: Foundational inspection development: code navigation, occupancy hazards, documentation, communication, and local enforcement processes.

emt.title: EMT
emt.summary: Use FireOpsSim for career direction and broad review, while your approved education program, state EMS office, medical direction, and current certification authority remain the source of truth.

aemt.title: Advanced EMT
aemt.summary: Use approved education, current state scope, medical direction, and certifying-agency requirements. FireOpsSim provides career and study support rather than protocol authority.

paramedic.title: Paramedic
paramedic.summary: Paramedic education and licensure are jurisdiction-dependent. Use accredited-program, state EMS, medical-direction, and certification sources for authoritative requirements.

do_pumper_pump_theory.title: Pump theory
do_pumper_pump_theory.note: Review centrifugal-pump basics, net pump pressure concepts, priming, cavitation, gauges, and apparatus-specific controls.

do_pumper_apparatus_inspection.title: Daily apparatus inspection
do_pumper_apparatus_inspection.note: Use your department inspection sheet and manufacturer information as the primary checklist; use FireOpsSim to organize the learning points.

do_pumper_engage_pump.title: Engage pump
do_pumper_engage_pump.note: Practice the decision sequence, but follow the exact manufacturer and department procedure for your apparatus.

do_pumper_hydrant_ops.title: Hydrant operations
do_pumper_hydrant_ops.note: Connect water-supply decisions to intake pressure, demand changes, and controlled valve operation.

do_pumper_drafting.title: Drafting
do_pumper_drafting.note: Focus on airtight suction setup, priming, lift, strainer placement, cavitation recognition, and maintaining a stable supply.

do_pumper_friction_loss.title: Friction loss + PDP
do_pumper_friction_loss.note: Practice the math, then compare the result with your department's hose/nozzle package and operational target pressures.

do_pumper_multiple_attack_lines.title: Multiple attack lines
do_pumper_multiple_attack_lines.note: Practice changes in demand, communication, pressure control, and water-supply awareness as lines open and close.

do_pumper_master_streams.title: Master stream operations
do_pumper_master_streams.note: Review high-flow demand, supply limitations, device/nozzle requirements, appliance considerations, and safe deployment.

do_pumper_relay_pumping.title: Relay pumping
do_pumper_relay_pumping.note: Practice source/intermediate/attack pumper roles, communications, pressure management, and failure recognition.

do_pumper_troubleshooting.title: Pump/supply troubleshooting
do_pumper_troubleshooting.note: Work one variable at a time: supply, valve position, air leaks, restrictions, cavitation, governor/mode, then discharge-side causes.
